text.en: Dog owners consistently praise Scott for his polite, professional, and patient demeanour with every client. Reviewers value his calm communication and willingness to let anxious owners stay during appointments. Handlers emphasize that he listens attentively to instructions and treats dogs with genuine affection.

Clients frequently point out how quickly nervous, elderly, or rescue dogs settle into their grooming appointments. Reviewers highlight swift nail clipping that causes no fuss or distress, even for dogs that typically struggle at the groomers. Pets leave feeling relaxed rather than agitated after their visits.

Owners report exceptional results for both regular maintenance trims and full breed styling. Dogs consistently leave the salon looking sharp, evenly cut, and smelling wonderful. Reviewers highlight thorough attention to detail, noting that coats remain neat and easy to manage long after the appointment.

q.en: Can owners stay during the grooming session?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that Scott allows owners to stay beside their dog if the pet feels nervous or unsettled.

q.en: Are anxious or older dogs accommodated for nail trims?

a.en: Yes, reviewers specifically highlight quick, stress-free nail clipping for elderly and nervous dogs.

q.en: How do clients describe the grooming results?

a.en: Owners report that dogs leave looking tidy, smelling clean, and styled accurately to breed standards.
